```{r}
outputdir <- "./figs/"
if(!dir.exists(outputdir)){
  dir.create(outputdir)
}

ggsave2_tri <- function(plot, wid = 9, hei=9){
  plot_name <- deparse(substitute(plot))
  
  #png
  file_name <- paste(outputdir,plot_name, ".png", sep = "",collapse = "")
  ggsave(filename = file_name,plot = plot,device = "png",width = wid, height = hei,dpi = 300,units = "cm")
  
  
  #pdf
  file_name <- paste(outputdir,plot_name, ".pdf", sep = "",collapse = "")
  # ggsave(filename = file_name,plot = plot,device = "pdf",width = wid, height = hei,dpi = 300,units = "cm")
  
  #pptx
  file_name <- paste(outputdir,plot_name, ".pptx", sep = "",collapse = "")
  plot_ed <- rvg::dml(ggobj = plot,width = wid, height = hei)
  
  doc <- read_pptx() %>%
    add_slide('Title and Content', 'Office Theme') %>%
    ph_with(value = "", location = ph_location_type(type = "title")) %>%
    ph_with(value = plot_ed, location = ph_location(type = "body",width = cm2inch(wid), height = cm2inch(hei),left = 2, top = 2))
  doc %>%
    print(target = file_name)
  
}



inch2cm <- function(x){
  return(x/0.39370)
}
cm2inch <- function(x){
  return(0.39370*x)
}

p2cm <- function(x){
  return(as.integer(0.008466666666666667 * x))
}

cm2p <- function(x){
  return(as.integer(118.11023622047244 *x))
}

append_list <- function(l, x){
  xname  <- deparse(substitute(x))
  l[[xname]] <- x
  return(l)
}

# load function
get_vals <- function(l){
  lnames <- names(l)
  for(n in lnames){
    assign(n, l[[n]], pos = .GlobalEnv)
  }
  return(lnames)
}
```

```{r}
# 正常範囲の定義
cutoff_values <- list(
  RESP = c(12, 24),
  TEMPR = c(36, 38.4),
  PULSE = c(70, 109),
  BPM = c(70, 109))

df_cutoff_values <- cutoff_values %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  t() %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  mutate(name = rownames(.)) %>% 
  `colnames<-`(c("lower_limit", "upper_limit", "name")) %>% 
  mutate(median_of_range = (lower_limit+upper_limit)/2) %>% 
  mutate(range_of_safe = upper_limit - median_of_range)

df_cutoff_values
```

```{r}
library(ggfortify)
library(gghighlight)

library(rstan)
library(bayesplot)

# 計算の高速化
rstan_options(auto_write = TRUE)
options(mc.cores = parallel::detectCores())

ex_pars <- c(
  "dmg_ijs_div",
  "trend_ijs_div",
  "as0", "mes_mu_ijks", "mu_phi_ijs", "sigma_dt", "all_outs"
)

ex_conds <- c("RESP", "BPM", "TEMPR", "PULSE")

ij_coef <- 1e+6
max_i <- 500


f_stn <- "ssm_801_4_redvar_rs.stan"
c_and_c <- 4

prs <- c("dmg_ijs[1]", "dmg_ijs[2]", "dmg_ijs[3]"
         # ,"dmg_ijs[4]",
         ,"phi_ijs[1]", "phi_ijs[2]", "phi_ijs[3]"
         # , "phi_ijs[4]"
         ,"as[1]"
         ,"coef_dt_div"
         # , "as[2]"
         )

```


```{r}
l_eval <- list()

for(i in 1:length(ex_conds)){
  tic()
  excon <- ex_conds[[i]]
  
  print(excon)
  f_out_l <- f_stn %>% 
    str_replace("\\.stan", 
                str_c("_on" ,excon, "_", ts,"_exres_list.rds", collapse = "", sep = ""))
  f_out_l %>% print()
  
  f_out_smr <- str_c("./figs/stan_smr_on" ,excon, "_", ts, "_exsmr.xlsx", collapse = "", sep = "")
  
  df_j <- left_join(df_vit,
                    df_icu_target %>% 
                      dplyr::select(PT_ID, JIPAD_ID, ADM_DT),
                    by = c("PT_ID"="PT_ID"), 
                    relationship = "many-to-many") %>% 
  dplyr::select(PT_ID, ADM_DT, everything()) %>% 
  mutate(sub_DT=ADM_DT-dt) %>% 
  filter(sub_DT>=0) %>% 
  dplyr::select(PT_ID, ADM_DT, dt, sub_DT, everything()) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(cols=c("PULSE", "RESP", "BPL", "BPH", "BPM", "TEMPR")) %>%
  filter(value!=0) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(df_cutoff_values, by = "name") %>% 
  filter(!name %in% c("BPL", "BPH")) %>%
  filter((name == "RESP" & value<=50 & value>=1) | name != "RESP") %>%
  filter(name == excon) %>%
  mutate(abn_value = (value -median_of_range) %>% 
           abs()) %>% 
  group_by(name) %>% 
  mutate(sd_name = sd(abn_value),
         abn_value_std = abn_value/range_of_safe) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  dplyr::select(JIPAD_ID, PT_ID, ADM_DT, dt, sub_DT, name, value, abn_value,abn_value_std) %>%
  distinct() %>% 
  group_by(JIPAD_ID) %>% 
  arrange(JIPAD_ID, dt) %>% 
  mutate(hour = sub_DT/3600) %>%
  mutate(hrs = as.numeric(hour)) %>%
  filter(hrs < 72) %>% 
  mutate(dt_num = as.numeric(dt)) %>% 
  mutate(lag_dt = lag(dt),
         lag_dt_num = as.numeric(lag_dt),
         delta_obs_num = dt_num - lag_dt_num,
         delta_obs_time = (dt - lag_dt) %>% 
           as.numeric())  %>% 
  mutate(lead_dt = lead(dt),
         lead_dt_num = as.numeric(lead_dt),
         next_obs_num = dt_num - lead_dt_num,
         next_obs_time = (dt - lead_dt_num) %>% 
           as.numeric()) %>% 
  mutate(delta_obs_time_cmp = if_else(delta_obs_num ==0, NA, delta_obs_num) %>% 
           vctrs::vec_fill_missing(., direction = "down") %>% 
           if_else(is.na(.), 0, .) %>% 
           magrittr::divide_by(3600) %>% 
           magrittr::divide_by(24)) %>% 
  mutate(next_obs_time_cmp = if_else(next_obs_num ==0, NA, next_obs_num) %>%
           vctrs::vec_fill_missing(., direction = "up") %>%
           magrittr::divide_by(3600) %>%
           magrittr::divide_by(24) %>% 
           magrittr::multiply_by(-1) %>% 
           if_else(is.na(.), 
                   hrs %>% 
                     magrittr::divide_by(24),
                   .)
         ) %>%
  # mutate(next_obs_time_cmp_wohrs = if_else(next_obs_num ==0, NA, next_obs_num) %>%
  #          vctrs::vec_fill_missing(., direction = "up") %>%
  #          magrittr::divide_by(3600) %>%
  #          magrittr::divide_by(24) %>% 
  #          magrittr::multiply_by(-1)
  #        ) %>%
  mutate(ind_j = factor(dt) %>% as.numeric()) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  mutate(ind_i = factor(JIPAD_ID) %>% as.numeric()) %>% 
  #pt ind filtering
  # filter(ind_i == 9) %>% 
  # mutate(ind_i = factor(JIPAD_ID) %>% as.numeric()) %>% 
  mutate(ind_ij = ((ij_coef * ind_i) + ind_j) %>% 
           factor() %>% 
           as.numeric()) %>% 
  mutate(ind_k = factor(name) %>% 
           as.numeric())  %>% 
  filter(ind_i <= max_i)


  df_j %>% 
    group_by(name) %>% 
    summarise(sd_name = sd(abn_value_std))  %>% 
    print()
  
  df_j_ijdt <- df_j %>% 
    dplyr::select(ind_i, ind_j, ind_ij, delta_obs_time_cmp, next_obs_time_cmp,
                  # next_obs_time_cmp_wohrs,next_obs_num, next_obs_time, 
                  hrs) %>% 
    distinct()
  total_obs <- df_j$ind_ij %>% 
  max()
  total_pts <- df_j$ind_i %>% 
    max()
  total_name <- df_j$ind_k %>% 
    max()
  total_measure <- df_j %>% nrow()
  
  data <- list(
    grainsize= 1,
    total_pts = total_pts,
    total_obs = total_obs,
    total_name = total_name,
    total_measure = total_measure,
    
    obs_is = df_j_ijdt$ind_i,
    obs_js = df_j_ijdt$ind_j,
    obs_ijs = df_j_ijdt$ind_ij,
    obs_dts = df_j_ijdt$delta_obs_time_cmp,
    
    mes_is = df_j$ind_i,
    mes_ijs = df_j$ind_ij,
    mes_ks = df_j$ind_k,
    mes_values = df_j$value,
    mes_abn_values = df_j$abn_value_std
  )
  
  p_pre <- ggplot()+
  theme_pubr(legend = c(0.8, 0.8))+
  geom_histogram(data = df_j,
                 aes(x=abn_value_std, fill=name),
                 color="black",
                 position = "dodge")+
  coord_cartesian(expand = F)
# +
#   scale_x_log10()
# +
#   facet_wrap(~name)
  p_pre %>% grid::grid.draw()
  
  tic()

  ft1 <- stan(
    file = f_stn,
    data = data,
    seed = 12345,
    iter = 5000,
    warmup = 3000,
    thin = 1,
    chains = c_and_c,
    control = list(
      adapt_delta = 0.90,
      max_treedepth = 15)
    ,cores = parallel::detectCores()
    ,save_warmup = F
    ,include = F
    ,pars = ex_pars
  )

  toc()

  pairs(ft1, pars = prs)

  ft1 %>% rhat() %>% mcmc_rhat()

  stan_ac(ft1,pars =prs) %>% grid::grid.draw()

  stan_dens(ft1,
          pars =prs,
          separate_chains = T) %>% grid::grid.draw()

  stan_trace(ft1,inc_warmup=F,
           pars =prs) %>% grid::grid.draw()

  df_m_smr <- summary(ft1)$summary

  df_m_smr %>% openxlsx::write.xlsx(., f_out_smr)


  if(f_out_l != f_stn){
  l_eval[[excon ]] <- 
    list() %>%
      append_list(ft1) %>%
      append_list(df_j_ijdt) %>%
      append_list(df_j)  %>%
      saveRDS(f_out_l)
  }
  toc()
}

```
